messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the person's identity to match the person in the reference photo. Use the reference photo only to determine the target person's facial identity and skin tone. Apply that skin tone consistently to the face and body. Retain the current hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, scene, and camera.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the person's identity to match the person in the reference photo. Only use the reference photo to determine the target person's facial identity and skin tone. Apply that skin tone consistently to the face and body, while retaining the current hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, scene, and camera.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands on a cobblestone street, turning her body from a side profile to face away from the camera, then rotating back to face forward while posing with her hands on her hips and adjusting her hair.","camera":"A static, medium-full shot capturing the character from the shins up against the street background.","clothing":"A white, floral-print romper with pink and blue flowers, featuring an open back and three-quarter sleeves, paired with pink flat shoes.","hair_color":"Red.","hairstyle":"Short red hair with bangs, tied into a small top bun.","identity":"A 3D-rendered female character with a slim build and tanned skin.","scene":"A virtual, European-style street with cobblestone paving, brick and stone buildings, black streetlamps, and a Union Jack flag hanging from a building on the left."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output remains visually almost identical to the source: the character keeps the same red hair and bun, floral romper, pink shoes, pose sequence, street scene, and camera framing. No clear facial identity change or consistent skin-tone change toward the reference is visible in the sampled frames.
arguments.requested_change: Change the character's facial identity and skin tone to match the reference photo, while retaining the current hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, scene, and camera.
uncertain: Whether any very subtle facial or skin-tone change occurred is hard to judge from the provided frames, but no visible change was observed.
